jp: じゃあ、少し踏み込んだ質問をするわ
rm: Jaa, sukoshi fumikonda shitsumon wo suru wa
en: Then, I'll ask you a question that I've been thinking about for a while.

jp: 1年Dクラスに現在、パートナー探しで苦労している生徒はどれくらいいるのかしら?
rm: 1 nen D class ni genzai, partner sagashi de kurou shite iru seito wa dore kurai iru no kashira?
en: How many students are currently struggling to find a partner in D-Class for a year?

jp: 現時点では15人近くいます
en: At the moment, there are about 15 people.

jp: 思ったよりも多いわね
rm: Omotta yori mo ooi wa ne
en: First of all, it's a lot more than I thought.

jp: ナナセさん、もし許されるのなら、あなたたちと大きな契約を結びたい
rm: Nanasesan, moshi yurusareru no nara, anatatachi to ookina keiyaku wo musubitai
en: Nanase-san, if you're going to forgive me, I want to make a big deal with you guys.

jp: 私とナナセさんで、その15組のパートナーの組み合わせを決めて、一斉に成立させてしまえればと思っているの
rm: Watakushi to Nanasesan de, sono 15 kumi no partner no kumiawase wo kimete, issei ni seiritsu sasete shimaereba to omotte iru no
en: I, and Nanase-san, have decided on a combination of 15 groups of partners, and I think we should be able to establish them together.

jp: 素晴らしい申し出だと思いますが、無償で手助けすることをホーセン君は絶対に認めないです
rm: Subarashii moushide da to omoimasuga, mushou de tedasuke suru koto wo hoosenkun wa zettai ni mitomenai desu
en: ...... I think it's a wonderful request, but Housen-kun will never admit that he helped you without a certificate.

jp: どうして?彼には何のデメリットもないはずよ
rm: Dou shite? kare ni wa nan no demerit mo nai hazu yo
en: Why? He doesn't have any demerits.

jp: それでも、やはり、ホーセン君は認めないと思います
rm: Sore de mo, yahari, hoosenkun wa mitomenai to omoimasu
en: Even so, I still don't think Housen-kun will accept it.

jp: なるほどな、そういうことか
rm: Naruhodo na, sou iu koto ka
en: I see. So that's how it is.

jp: ホーセンの考えについて、ひとつだけ分かったことがある
rm: Hoosen no kangae ni tsuite, hitotsu dake wakatta koto ga aru
en: There is one thing I understood about Housen's thoughts.
